lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: genitive masculine indefinite (form VII) active participle
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مُّنْهَمِرٍ is in the derivative form: مُنْهَمِرٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
هـ/م/ر   h–m–r to pour down, to shed, a shower of rain, rain clouds; to talk too much, a talkative person; to give generously. Of this root, مُنْهَمِرٌ munhamir occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مُنْهَمِرٌ munhamir [act. part. of v. VII انْهَمَرَ ʾinhamara] pouring down profusely

(54:11) فَفَتَحْنَا أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَاءٍ مُنْهَمِرٍ so We opened the gates of the sky with torrential water.
